_about: Recurring FICTIONAL characters for series (docs/viral-playbook-2026-11-12.md: accounts with a fixed persona build followers; 95% of our viewers were new and none came from the Following feed). Use { "cast": "<id>" } on a character in a job. These are cartoon characters in skits. Never present them as real customers, never give them quotes about results, and never model them on a real person (AGENTS.md rule 2).

bu_saad.persona: Practical shop owner who answers every customer himself on WhatsApp and is always one message behind. Proud, a little stubborn, learns by seeing.
bu_saad.world: bg shop or room; phoneHand, counter

dr_sara.persona: Careful clinic owner who hates losing evening enquiries and repeating the same answers. Calm until the phone will not stop.

am_osman.persona: Veteran Sudanese merchant who trusts his paper ledger and is suspicious of software until he sees his own numbers on the phone.

noura.persona: The guide. Asks one sharp question, shows instead of telling, never pushes. She is the only character who speaks for Sudegy.

hamad.persona: Young salesman who forgets follow-ups and blames the phone. Comic relief; his mistakes start the story.
hamad.world: bg shop or office; phoneHand, laptop
